purpose: diagnose whether the matched 10-epoch budget limits EcoHydroGraph

pass_rules.enter_u2: 30 or 60 epochs improves mean MAE by at least 5 percent over 10 epochs, or 10 epochs has not reached a validation-loss plateau
pass_rules.retain_budget: if 30 and 60 epochs do not improve by 5 percent and validation loss has plateaued, retain the 10-epoch matched budget
pass_rules.no_claim_change: U1 is a convergence diagnostic and cannot change the frozen T8/T9 result
